title: Magic Graph
rules: Place numbers in the circles so that every line adds up to the same target sum. Each number can only be used once.
allLinesSameValue: All lines sum to same value

win.title: Solved!
win.mathInsight: Math Insight: You used {{nodeCount}} numbers across {{lineCount}} lines!

grandmaster.tryAgain: Can you find a better solution?

auditor.title: Constraint Violation
auditor.singleLine: 1 line cannot reach the target sum with the remaining numbers. Look for the pulsing red line!
auditor.multipleLines: {{count}} lines cannot reach the target sum. You may need to backtrack and try different placements.

starter.title: Best Next Move
starter.subtext: Look for the green glowing node!

additionBasics.title: Addition Basics
additionBasics.message: All numbers on a line must add up to the target sum. Try different orders!

sharedNumbers.title: Shared Numbers
sharedNumbers.message: The center node appears in BOTH lines. This number is counted twice in the total!

magicConstant.title: Magic Constant
magicConstant.message: In a magic triangle, the sum of all numbers ÷ 3 + (corner sum) = target × 3

magicConstantFormula.title: Magic Constant Formula
magicConstantFormula.message: For a 3×3 magic square with 1-9: Magic Sum = n(n²+1)/2 = 3(10)/2 = 15

intersectionPoints.title: Intersection Points
intersectionPoints.message: Nodes where multiple lines meet are key - they affect multiple sums at once!

centerFirst.title: Center First
centerFirst.message: Try placing the middle number (3) in the center. Why might this work?

centerNumber.title: Center Number
centerNumber.message: The center of a 3×3 magic square is always 5 (the middle number)!

workOutward.title: Work Outward
workOutward.message: Start from shared nodes and work outward to the edges.

checkWork.title: Check Your Work
checkWork.message: A red line means the sum is wrong. Try removing a number and replacing it.

whereToStart.title: Where to Start?
whereToStart.message: Look for nodes that appear in multiple lines - these are key positions!

buildFromKnowns.title: Build from Knowns
buildFromKnowns.message: Pick a line with some filled numbers. Calculate what's needed to reach the sum.

almostThere.title: Almost There!
almostThere.message: Use algebra: if one line is mostly filled, the missing number = target - current sum.

editor.title: Custom Puzzle Editor
editor.instructions: Create your own graph topology and generate puzzles from it
editor.selectAtLeastTwo: Select at least 2 nodes to create a line
editor.notEnoughNumbers: Need at least as many numbers as nodes
editor.noSolutionFound: No valid solution found. Try different numbers or topology.
